scale.source: Dicionario da Real Academia Galega, "billón": "Un millón de millóns."

group_mark.source: CLDR 48 numbers, gl (latn): decimal ",", group " "; the dot groups digits as in es and pt-PT ("1.000.000"), as ovos-number-parser reads gl.

space_groups.source: CLDR 48 numbers, gl (latn): decimal ",", group " ": the group mark is a space, so "1 000 000" is one number.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: RAG Normas 16.1: "Cento, millón, billón, trillón, aínda que expresan número, funcionan como substantivos, igual que ducia, decena, centena." A plural scale noun with no count ("millóns de persoas") names no number.

scale_noun_agrees.source: RAG Normas 16.1: "Cento, millón, billón, trillón, aínda que expresan número, funcionan como substantivos, igual que ducia, decena, centena."; Dicionario da Real Academia Galega, "billón": "Un millón de millóns." Dicionario RAG, "billón": "No firmamento hai centos de billóns de estrelas": the noun takes the plural after a count above one.

joiner_tens_units.source: RAG e ILG, Normas ortográficas e morfolóxicas do idioma galego (2003), 16.1 Cardinais: "cero", "un/unha", "dous/dúas", "dezaseis", "vinte e un / vinte e unha", "trinta e un, trinta e unha", "cen", "cento un, cento unha", "douscentos / duascentas", "cincocentos / cincocentas, quiñentos/ -as", "mil"; 16.1: "Cando os numerais vinte, trinta, corenta..., noventa van seguidos da conxunción e"

joiner_after_hundred.source: RAG e ILG, Normas ortográficas e morfolóxicas do idioma galego (2003), 16.1 Cardinais: "cero", "un/unha", "dous/dúas", "dezaseis", "vinte e un / vinte e unha", "trinta e un, trinta e unha", "cen", "cento un, cento unha", "douscentos / duascentas", "cincocentos / cincocentas, quiñentos/ -as", "mil": "cento un" takes no "e". No source writes a joiner after the hundred, and none reads it as two numbers either. A text that writes one ("cento e vinte") means one number, so the joiner is optional when reading: the reading takes it when it is there, and the bound hundred keeps its value. ovos-number-parser numbers_gl.py (a lead) writes "cento e un".

joiner_between_groups.source: RAG e ILG, Normas ortográficas e morfolóxicas do idioma galego (2003), 16.1 Cardinais: "cero", "un/unha", "dous/dúas", "dezaseis", "vinte e un / vinte e unha", "trinta e un, trinta e unha", "cen", "cento un, cento unha", "douscentos / duascentas", "cincocentos / cincocentas, quiñentos/ -as", "mil": the groups stand side by side as the hundreds do ("cento un"); RAG does not write "e" after "mil". Text also writes "mil e" ("dous mil e vinte e seis"), and a split reading gives a wrong value. Maintainer ruling: "be lenient and read 'mil e' as one number". So the joiner is optional, and both forms read as one number.

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: joiner_between_groups is "never", with the source quoted there: no joiner follows the thousands, so no count follows one.

comma_between_classes.source: No source opened shows a comma between two classes of one number, so a comma ends a number.

joiner_before_last_group.source: joiner_between_groups is "optional", with the source and the maintainer ruling quoted there: the joiner before the last group is optional too.

ordinal_style.source: RAG Normas 16.2 Ordinais: "primeiro", "sétimo", "undécimo / décimo primeiro", "vixésimo primeiro", "trixésimo", "cuadraxésimo", "quincuaxésimo", "sesaxésimo", "septuaxésimo", "octoxésimo", "nonaxésimo", "centésimo", "milésimo", "millonésimo"; "Todas estas formas admiten morfemas de xénero e número, que nas formas compostas só se unen ao último elemento (décimo primeira)"

clock_before.source: gl.wikipedia "Hora", edit note: "10 de novembro de 2025 ás 16:06": "ás" before a time; "h" is the symbol of the hour ("3 h 25 m 13 s"). An hour and minutes written with a point next to one of these words are a time of day, not a decimal.

clock_after.source: gl.wikipedia "Hora", edit note: "10 de novembro de 2025 ás 16:06": "ás" before a time; "h" is the symbol of the hour ("3 h 25 m 13 s"). An hour and minutes written with a point next to one of these words are a time of day, not a decimal.

decimal_marker.source: CLDR 48 numbers, gl (latn): decimal ",", group " "; "coma" names the decimal sign, as ovos-number-parser numbers_gl.py DECIMAL_MARKER reads it. The comma marks the decimals, so "punto" is no decimal marker (docs/rulings.md, "Decimals").

minus.source: The minus word, as in es and pt; ovos-number-parser numbers_gl.py NEGATIVE_SIGN.

minus_idioms.source: ovos-number-parser numbers_gl.py NEGATIVE_IDIOMS: "polo menos", "ao menos", "a menos que", "máis ou menos".

article_one.source: RAG Normas 16.1: "Os numerais un, unha, cando son adxectivos, contraen [...] da mesma maneira ca os artigos indeterminados".

of.source: RAG Normas 16.1: "Cento, millón, billón, trillón, aínda que expresan número, funcionan como substantivos, igual que ducia, decena, centena." "No firmamento hai centos de billóns de estrelas" (Dicionario RAG, "billón").

fraction_of.source: RAG Normas 16.4 Partitivos: "medio, -a", "terzo, -a", "cuarto, -a", "onceavo, -a", "doceavo, -a", "centésimo, -a", "milésimo, -a", "millonésimo, -a"; "a partir de 1/11 [...] o partitivo faise engadindo ao cardinal o sufixo -avo: (1/16) un dezaseisavo"

denominator_particle.source: RAG Normas 16.4 Partitivos: "medio, -a", "terzo, -a", "cuarto, -a", "onceavo, -a", "doceavo, -a", "centésimo, -a", "milésimo, -a", "millonésimo, -a"; "a partir de 1/11 [...] o partitivo faise engadindo ao cardinal o sufixo -avo: (1/16) un dezaseisavo": the suffix -avo joins the cardinal, so no separate particle.

class_noun.source: No class noun is listed for Galician.

half_unit.source: RAG Normas 16.4 Partitivos: "medio, -a", "terzo, -a", "cuarto, -a", "onceavo, -a", "doceavo, -a", "centésimo, -a", "milésimo, -a", "millonésimo, -a"; "a partir de 1/11 [...] o partitivo faise engadindo ao cardinal o sufixo -avo: (1/16) un dezaseisavo": "medio" before a unit noun is half of that unit.

abbreviation.source: No Galician number word doubles as a month abbreviation.

lone_decimal_mark.source: A mark before the first digit makes the digits decimals (".5"), as in pt-PT.

range_cue.source: en.wiktionary, Galician "entre" (alternative forms "antre", "ontre"), preposition: "between, among". In "entre A e B" the "e" joins the two limits, so it ends the first number where the words split into two numbers, the first smaller.
